name: @pipeworx/mcp-cn-law

tools.name: cn_search_laws
tools.description: Search mainland China's national laws, administrative regulations, local regulations, and judicial interpretations (司法解释) by title or keyword — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "Chinese law on X", "中国法律", citation lookup, or finding a statute's official record id. Source: NPC National Database of Laws and Regulations (全国人大常委会法工委). Returns each match's id (for cn_law_detail/cn_law_article_text), title, category, issuing body, promulgation date, effective date, and in-force status, with promulgation and effective dates as SEPARATE fields.

query.description: Title/keyword in Chinese, e.g. "个人信息保护法", "公司法", "数据安全法".

exact.description: true = exact title match (use for a known law name); false/omitted = fuzzy word-segmented search (broader, can include partial matches).

category.description: Restrict to one category. "judicial_interpretation" covers SPC/SPP/jointly-issued 司法解释. Default "any".

tools.name: cn_law_detail
tools.description: Metadata for one law/regulation/interpretation record from cn_search_laws: title, category, issuing body, promulgation date, effective date, and in-force status, plus whether article-level text can be extracted via cn_law_article_text. Source: NPC National Database of Laws and Regulations.

tools.name: cn_law_article_text
tools.description: The Chinese text of ONE specific article/provision of a law, regulation, or judicial interpretation found via cn_search_laws — not the whole document. Extracted from the official PDF the NPC database itself serves (that database has no per-article JSON text field). Returns found:false with an explanation rather than a snippet when the article cannot be located or the PDF cannot be read — this tool never fabricates text.

article.description: Article number (13) or the Chinese citation itself ("第十三条", "十三条之一").

tools.name: cn_search_admin_regulations
tools.description: Search mainland Chinese administrative regulations (行政法规) by title — a second official copy of the same regulations cn_search_laws covers, used here specifically because its detail pages carry the FULL regulation text inline as plain HTML (cn_search_laws/cn_law_article_text route through a PDF instead). Source: Ministry of Justice (司法部), National Administrative Regulations Database.

query.description: Title keyword in Chinese, e.g. "公司法" (matches implementing regulations), "数据安全".

tools.name: cn_admin_regulation_text
tools.description: Full Chinese text of one administrative regulation found via cn_search_admin_regulations, plus its revision-date history. Source: Ministry of Justice, National Administrative Regulations Database.

tools.name: cn_guiding_cases_list
tools.description: Index of the Supreme People's Court's official Guiding Cases (指导性案例) — binding case guidance for lower courts, numbered sequentially and released in batches. Page 1 is the newest batch. Source: court.gov.cn, 审判业务 > 指导性案例.

page.description: Page number, 1 = newest (default 1). Higher numbers go further back.

tools.name: cn_guiding_case_detail
tools.description: Full text of one Supreme People's Court Guiding Case from cn_guiding_cases_list: title, issuing source, publication date, keywords (关键词), holding (裁判要点), and the full case narrative, in Chinese. Source: court.gov.cn.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cn-law forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cn-law pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
